name: NotebookLM
verdict: No third-party OAuth or partner program. Each customer needs NotebookLM Enterprise licensed in their own Google Cloud project, the API is Pre-GA, and your agent must act as an IAM principal there.
needGuide: No — there is no supported connector path; each customer's Google Cloud admin would have to grant your agent access in their project.

auth.detail: Only NotebookLM Enterprise (Gemini Notebook Enterprise) has an API, and it is Preview (v1alpha). Docs show a Google Cloud IAM bearer token from `gcloud auth print-access-token` against {us|eu|global}-discoveryengine.googleapis.com/v1alpha/projects/PROJECT_NUMBER/locations/LOCATION/notebooks. No developer-registered OAuth app or scope list is documented. Consumer NotebookLM has no public API (per brief; not re-verified).

effort.timeToFirstTest: unknown (needs a Google Cloud project with NotebookLM Enterprise licenses)
effort.timeToProduction: unknown; per-customer project setup on a Preview API

approval.gate: No third-party OAuth or partner program. Each customer needs NotebookLM Enterprise set up and licensed in their own Google Cloud project, and the API is Pre-GA ('as is', limited support). Your agent must act as an IAM principal in that project; a service account or delegated user is likely, and Google OAuth verification likely applies if you use user tokens with Cloud scopes (unconfirmed).

scopes.why: No connector path: IAM-based Cloud API, no OAuth scopes for third-party apps.
scopes.summary: IAM-based, not OAuth scopes. Cloud NotebookLM User role is required for sharing recipients. Share roles are PROJECT_ROLE_OWNER, WRITER, READER and NOT_SHARED. Operations: create, get, listRecentlyViewed, batchDelete, share. Sources and chat are not in the documented API surface.

cost: Requires paid NotebookLM Enterprise licenses plus a Google Cloud project (pricing not checked)
prerequisites: Account and owner: A Google Cloud project owner/admin who can set up Gemini Notebook Enterprise, buy licenses and assign IAM roles. Use a company-owned Cloud org.
Where you register: No app registration. Work happens inside a customer's Google Cloud project: set up Gemini Notebook Enterprise, assign licenses, grant the Cloud NotebookLM User IAM role.
Cost: Requires paid NotebookLM Enterprise licenses plus a Google Cloud project (pricing not checked)

registerAt.path: No app registration. Work happens inside a customer's Google Cloud project: set up Gemini Notebook Enterprise, assign licenses, grant the Cloud NotebookLM User IAM role.

steps.do: Decide the integration model: the customer's own Google Cloud project hosts NotebookLM Enterprise, and your agent calls into it.
In a test Google Cloud project, set up Gemini Notebook Enterprise and obtain licenses (see the 'set up' links on the API doc page).
Grant the Cloud NotebookLM User IAM role to your test user or service account in IAM & Admin.
Call POST .../v1alpha/projects/PROJECT_NUMBER/locations/global/notebooks with `Authorization: Bearer $(gcloud auth print-access-token)` to create a notebook.
Exercise notebooks.get, listRecentlyViewed, share (PROJECT_ROLE_OWNER/WRITER/READER) and batchDelete.
Document for customers the IAM role, license and region (us/eu/global) they must set up, and the token model you use.
Review the cross-tenant access model (service account vs delegated user) before offering it to customers.

roles.team: A Google Cloud project owner/admin who can set up Gemini Notebook Enterprise, buy licenses and assign IAM roles. Use a company-owned Cloud org.
roles.console: Google Cloud IAM: add principals and assign the Cloud NotebookLM User role in the project. No separate developer console for NotebookLM.
roles.customer: Customer Google Cloud admin must enable NotebookLM Enterprise, assign licenses and grant the Cloud NotebookLM User role to whatever identity your agent uses. Org policies or IAM can block this.

testing: Use your own Google Cloud project with a trial or licensed NotebookLM Enterprise instance.
Limits seen in docs: listRecentlyViewed returns up to 500 notebooks, and batchDelete returns {} even for missing IDs.

blockers.fix: Target Enterprise customers only, or do not integrate.

blockers.problem: API is v1alpha/Preview and may change
blockers.fix: Pin the version and monitor release notes.

blockers.problem: Customer needs licenses, a project number and the right regional endpoint
blockers.fix: Collect PROJECT_NUMBER, LOCATION and ENDPOINT_LOCATION during onboarding.

blockers.problem: Third-party identity customers use a different notebook URL domain (notebook.cloud.google vs notebook.cloud.google.com)
blockers.fix: Build links from the customer's identity type.

automation.agentCan: Write the REST client, create/share/list notebooks in a test project, draft customer onboarding instructions (IAM role, licenses, region), and script gcloud setup commands.
automation.humanMust: Buy or enable NotebookLM Enterprise licenses, approve billing, sign in to Google Cloud, assign IAM roles, and make the cross-tenant security decision.

uncertain: Only the NotebookLM Enterprise API doc was read.
Not confirmed: whether third-party multi-tenant OAuth or Workforce Identity access is supported, license prices, GA date, and the consumer-API claim.
Only one source was fetched, so the 2-source minimum is not met.
